intro.title: Problem Solving
paragraphs: You have stepped into the office storage room to grab a new stapler. But the Storage Manager has left you a note about a bigger issue — things keep going missing in here.

This room is about one crucial aspect of problem solving: clearly defining the problem before jumping to solutions. Look around, investigate, and try not to make the first assumption the final answer.
Read the sticky note on the door to get started. Then let the room tell you what is really going on.

dialogues.step1: Hey, have you got a minute?
dialogues.step2: I just came by to grab a new keyboard…
dialogues.step3: … but I can't find a single keyboard in here!
dialogues.step4: Yeah, I was told we would have some in storage.
dialogues.step5: Oh well, at least the room looks a lot better than it usually does.
dialogues.step6: Maybe the mess isn't the problem. Maybe there's something entirely different going on.

userReplies.step4: Hmm… I just finished cleaning up here. I don't remember seeing any keyboards.
userReplies.step6: It could be… I guess I should try to figure it out.

stickyNote.title: A Note from the Storage Manager
stickyNote.letter:
Dear (username)

We've been having some issues in the storage room lately. Things keep going missing. Just the other day, we got a new shipment of chairs, and I can't find them anywhere!

I'm out of office, and unfortunately, I didn't have the time to look into it before I left…

Could you take a look? Owe you big time!

- Storage Manager
stickyNote.thought: And here I am, thinking I'm just stopping by to get a new stapler… Guess I better roll up my sleeves.

cleanRoom.introThought: Wow, the storage room has gotten pretty messy. I'm willing to bet that's the problem. I better clean up here.

knutConversation.title: Knut enters the storage room
knutConversation.startDialogue: Someone has walked into the storage room — it looks like Knut from the office. He seems to be looking for something.

investigate.introThought: Knut is right. Maybe the mess was never the real issue. Time to actually look around for clues.

vent.thought: A mouse… and a mouse. Cute or gross, depending on what you think. Could this little guy be the cause of all of this?

halfOpenDoor.thought: Perhaps someone left the door open… and someone got in and stole our equipment.

emptyShelf.thought: Did anything go missing from here?

cleaningChecklist.title: Cleaning Checklist
cleaningChecklist.content:
☐ Remove all trash and empty packaging
☐ Dust shelves
☐ Wipe down surfaces
☐ Clean floors
☐ Check that everything is in the right place
cleaningChecklist.thought: Someone already tried solving this problem by cleaning.

deliveryNotes.title: Delivery Notes
deliveryNotes.content:
Office Supplies Shipment
Delivery Date: Today
Delivered to: Storage Room

Received by: Storage Manager
deliveryNotes.thought: According to this, everything was delivered correctly… The mouse couldn't possibly have walked off with all of this?!

pansBox.thought: Pans… Pens… These labels all seem to be wrong!

labelPrinter.thought: This is probably what they use to label boxes.

marketsBox.thought: Someone changed the labels… and got it wrong!

phaseCompleteThoughts.phase1: That covers the obvious suspects. Let me keep searching — maybe there's a paper trail.
phaseCompleteThoughts.phase2: The cleaning and the delivery records line up. The problem must be somewhere else. Let's check the boxes themselves.
phaseCompleteThoughts.phase3: All three of these boxes had the wrong contents. This isn't a coincidence. Something is off with the labels.

defineProblem.question: What is the main problem in the storage room?

options.text: Someone broke in and stole equipment

tooltips.mess: Cleaning didn't solve anything. The mess is not the main problem.
tooltips.theft: There were some empty shelves, and the door was left open. But there is no hard proof that something was stolen.
tooltips.labels: Correct. The items were there the whole time, but they were stored under incorrect labels. This made it very difficult to find things in the storage room.
tooltips.delivery: The delivery note showed that everything was delivered correctly. The real problem must be something that happens after delivery.
tooltips.mouse: The storage room has a mouse problem, but this is not the main issue.

hints.stickyNote: There is a sticky note on the entry door. Click it to see what it says.
hints.readStickyNote: Knut needs your help. Continue the note to get started.
hints.cleanRoom: The room is cluttered. Click the boxes and trash on the floor to tidy up.
hints.boxesRemaining: Still some boxes and trash on the floor. Keep clicking them until the room is clean.
hints.waitForKnut: Knut is on his way — wait a moment.
hints.knutArrival: It looks like someone just walked in. Click Knut to talk to him.
hints.knutConversation: Hear Knut out. Pick the highlighted reply to continue the conversation.
hints.investigatePhase1: Now look around with fresh eyes. Click obvious suspects: damaged boxes, the vent, the door, empty shelves.
hints.investigatePhase2: The obvious suspects didn't explain everything. Click the cleaning checklist and the delivery notes for more clues.
hints.investigatePhase3: The records line up. Try opening the labelled boxes on the shelves.
hints.investigatePhase4: You have noticed the labels seem wrong. Click the label printer and the Markets box to confirm.
hints.defineProblem: Pick the option that actually explains what is wrong in the storage room.
hints.completion: The back door just unlocked. Click it to exit.
hints.default: Look around the storage room for interactive objects.

completion.title: Problem Solving Complete
completion.message:
Congratulations, you have completed the problem-solving room!

It was easy to assume that the issue with items going missing was caused by the mess. And it was natural to jump straight to a solution — cleaning and organizing the room.

But you soon discovered that this did not solve anything. The core issue had to be something else.

You therefore took a step back and explored alternative explanations. By gathering clues and evidence, you were able to identify the core issue: mislabelling of boxes.

The room represents a crucial aspect of problem-solving: clearly defining the problem before acting. Doing so can save you a lot of wasted time and energy.

Well done!

systemDialogues.investigateComplete: That's enough evidence. I think I can define the real problem now.
